generalAbilities.name: Ironsense
generalAbilities.description: The dragon can detect the presence of iron and other ferrous metals as a precise sense at the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Arcane Whirlwind
defensiveAbilities.description:
15 feet.

A vortex of fist-sized balls of pure magic swirls around the dragon. Air within the emanation is difficult terrain for Flying creatures other than the dragon. A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn within the aura takes 8d6 Force Damage damage (Basic DC 39 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Ray Displacement
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon is targeted with a ranged spell attack

Effect The dragon creates a field of distorted space between themself and the caster. The creature targeting the barrage dragon must roll the spell attack twice and take the worse result.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shrapnel Splash
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit with a melee weapon or unarmed attack

Effect The dragon's blood forms into hard spheres as it erupts from the wound, battering the attacker. The creature who dealt the triggering damage takes 9d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 44 Reflex Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: When the dragon scores a critical hit with a Strike, they recharge Scattershot.

offensiveAbilities.name: Force Pulse
offensiveAbilities.description:
◆ to ◆◆◆

The dragon emits pulses of energy that radiates outward in a 25ft Type:emanation, dealing (3d8+3) Force Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save).

For each action spent, a new pulse of energy is created and each subsequent pulse after the first is 5 feet larger than the previous one.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scattershot
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon exhales a cloud of small balls of pure energy that deal (11d4+11) Force Damage damage in a 60ft Type:cone with no save. The dragon can't use Scattershot again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The barrage archdragon transforms into pure energy and surges across the battlefield. They Fly up to their Speed, and during this movement they have resistance 30 to all damage (except spirit damage). At any point during this movement, the dragon can make up to two claw Strikes; each of these Strikes deals an additional (3d8+3) Force Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pushing Pulse
offensiveAbilities.description: The barrage dragon performs a 2-action Force Pulse. Each creature who fails its save is pushed 15 feet away from the dragon (30 feet on a critical failure).
